evidence_status: Retrospective reanalysis after Han outcomes and prior probes were inspected; no claim of unseen-source confirmation or external preregistration.
main_question: Does target-side scalar calibration regulate an unchanged partner branch on Han combinations whose outcomes are withheld from the current calibration?
source_selection: Report all; no source winner selected by Han; fixed equal-weight primary rank1 summary plus complete individual rows.
direction: D = native_selected_prediction - source_M0, retaining native source beta and zero choices; never silently replace D by native_prediction - target_additive.
sensitivity_readout: published on the identical 88 pairs, with the same procedure and its own permitted inputs/calibration responses
split_unit: unordered pair; all real repeats follow the same pair
target_novelty: Han pair responses withheld from target calibration, not necessarily a pair identity unseen in source training
zero_energy_rule: Retain archived coefficient routine: return 0 if summed direction energy is at most 1e-14. Log the energy and mark non-discriminating cases; do not reopen native zero corrections.
endpoint_arms: native: M0 + H D + alpha P D
target_anchor: H B + P M0 + alpha P D
references: native full-optimized whole shrink M0+gamma_full D
primary_contrast: partner SSE(original alpha1) - partner SSE(target-calibrated alpha)
mandatory_companion_contrast: partner SSE(partner_off alpha0) - partner SSE(target-calibrated alpha)
adaptation_contrast: partner SSE(source-fixed alpha) - partner SSE(target-calibrated alpha)
practical_utility_contrast: full SSE(B) - full SSE(target-anchored calibrated predictor)
primary_aggregation: Pool paired SSE over folds and repeats; equal-weight all five partitions and the three fixed rank1 sources. Preserve every source, repeat and partition result. Do not average fold percentages.
query_projection: Recompute H_Q and P_Q within each scientific query panel. Do not globally project concatenated out-of-fold predictions for the primary score.
multiplicity_and_dependence: No independence claim for sources, repeat-shared controls, overlapping seeds or deleted endpoints; effect sizes and full sensitivities, no invented universal success probability.

interpretation.control_better_than_raw_only: Damage mitigation, not evidence of useful nonzero partner retention.
interpretation.control_better_than_raw_and_off: Evidence of useful nonzero control on the specified measured task; inspect repeats, partition and readout sensitivity.
interpretation.control_better_than_source_alpha: Target calibration adds value over source-strength transfer under this task.
interpretation.partner_gain_but_full_worse_than_B: Local control benefit without demonstrated complete-predictor application advantage.
interpretation.anchor_only_improvement: Endpoint adaptation benefit, not partner-control benefit.
interpretation.zero_direction_or_identical_arms: No discriminating evidence for added control.
interpretation.adverse_or_unstable_outer_effect: Report failure/boundary; no query-driven redesign within this analysis.

targeted_checks_planned: change outer query responses without changing calibration coefficients or query predictions
verify endpoint preservation and equality of absolute full/partner SSE differences for each fixed endpoint arm
verify target anchoring leaves partner predictions unchanged
record immutable model hashes and zero target base-model-fit calls
checkpoint: Write parameters and predictions for each fold before scoring; resume only complete, verified folds and preserve all old outputs.
stop_rule: One fixed scalar analysis plus declared secondary families and readout; no new seeds, model classes, hyperparameter grids or mixture search in response to outcomes.
manuscript_action_now: None; retain v34 and all prior results. Integrate only after new execution, with accurate retrospective status.
